image_prompts.purpose: Main Week 2 studio scene for the opener, visual-reading task, and guided writing support.
image_prompts.visual_description: An adult Fashion Design studio scene with a worktable holding scissors, ruler, measuring tape, sketchbook, pencil, pattern paper, fabric, pins, and thread, plus a sewing machine nearby and a mannequin visible in the background.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a warm digital watercolor or polished educational illustration style with realistic adult proportions and clear object boundaries.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep the table central and uncluttered enough for object-location questions. Make each tool easy to recognize at small size.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid logos, luxury-brand cues, childish cartoon styling, crowded shelves, or tiny indistinct tools.

image_prompts.purpose: Vocabulary board for basic tools in the core matching activity.
image_prompts.visual_description: A clean vocabulary board displaying scissors, ruler, measuring tape, pencil, and eraser as separate visual units on a neutral background.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a clean educational illustration style with high clarity and simple shadows.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Space the objects evenly and keep each one large enough for beginner image matching.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid text labels inside the image, decorative clutter, or objects overlapping each other.

image_prompts.purpose: Vocabulary board for sewing tools in the core matching activity.
image_prompts.visual_description: A board showing needle, thread, pins, and a sewing machine with each item visually separated and easy to identify.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a realistic but simple classroom-illustration style.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Make the sewing machine side view clear and keep the needle and pins large enough for recognition.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid busy studio backgrounds and tiny metal details that disappear on small screens.

image_prompts.purpose: Vocabulary board for fashion tools and materials in the core matching activity.
image_prompts.visual_description: A visual board with mannequin, sketchbook, pattern paper, and fabric swatch arranged as clear separate objects.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a clean fashion-education illustration style with realistic proportions.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep the mannequin easy to distinguish from a real person and make the sketchbook and paper clearly visible.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid runway scenes, posed models, or detailed text on the sketchbook page.

image_prompts.purpose: Image-card support for the teacher-led naming and speaking session.
image_prompts.visual_description: A printable or projected flashcard-style set of the most important Week 2 objects: scissors, ruler, measuring tape, sewing machine, sketchbook, mannequin, and pattern paper.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a clean educational flashcard layout with adult-appropriate styling.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Give each card one object only and keep backgrounds neutral for fast recognition in class.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid decorative fonts, extra labels, and classroom posters in the background.
